name: Sunlight Sword
description: (Tag:defence+)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:holy)(Tag:holy+)(Tag:strength+)(Tag:weapon)A simple-looking expert Anor Londo straight blade holding Sunlight power. Raising it to praise the sun while imbuing energy strengthens you and nearby allies physically for 3 minutes, 30-minute cooldown. Boosts lightning and fire abilities channeled through it.
